$comment: Evidence ledger. The ONLY file in this design-repo allowed to cite paths outside the design-repo. Every citation is '<path relative to the design-repo folder>:<line>[-<line>]' plus a 'contains' anchor: a literal substring that must appear inside the cited line range. extraction/verify_all.py resolves each one against the sibling source tree when it exists and degrades to a WARNING (not a failure) when the design-repo is used standalone (e.g. unzipped elsewhere). Other repo files reference these entries by id (mv.*) only.

sourceProject.name: tines-clone (local React 18 + Vite 5 + Tailwind 3 rebuild of tines.com; this design-repo models only the homepage '/', the source has since grown a file-based router with many more pages)
sourceProject.note: Source tree is read-only evidence. Commercially sensitive: local reference only.
sourceProject.citationsRepinnedAgainst: Citations were re-pinned to the source tree as of the 'generation-safe' revision after later source commits (multi-page build, shared components) shifted lines; verify_all 'citations' resolves every one against the live tree.

mv.ia.template.claim: ia.json (hand-authored IA, validated by validate.mjs) declares exactly 1 route '/', 1 template 'template.home' and this 11-section order: chrome.site-nav, hero.intro, proof.logo-marquee, hero.wordmark-stage, hero.product-demo, narrative.monitor-banner, narrative.solution-panel, showcase.use-case-tabs, proof.why-tines, conversion.start-today-cta, chrome.site-footer. templates/templates.json mirrors it 1:1 (checked by verify_all ia-alignment when ../ia.json is present).

mv.ia.sections.claim: ia.json section definitions with implementedBy (Navbar.jsx, Hero.jsx x4, MonitorBanner.jsx, SolutionPanel.jsx, UseCases.jsx, WhyTines.jsx, CtaStartToday.jsx, Footer.jsx).

mv.app.order.claim: Real render order: shared Layout in App.jsx = Navbar, main(Outlet), Footer; the homepage page module (src/pages/index.jsx) renders Hero, MonitorBanner, SolutionPanel, UseCases, WhyTines, CtaStartToday. NOTE: the source has since gained a file-based react-router (src/pages/**) with many more routes; this design-repo still models only '/' (template.home) and is a snapshot of the homepage.

mv.tw.colors.purple.claim: Purple scale 1..99; purple.55 #714bd0 is --pageForeground (default text, borders, filled buttons, solution panel).

mv.tw.colors.tab.claim: Use-case tab colours it #007f4a, security #714bd0, finance #008784, people #c05100, operations #3565cc.

mv.tw.colors.panel.claim: Per-tab panel text / frame edge / toggle-pill colours.

mv.tw.colors.surface.claim: Translucent surfaces (nav blur 70% and backdrop 90% - now color-mix of the page-themed --page-bg, default lightest = rgba(252,249,245,.7/.9); frosted .65, tag .55, card border .14, timeline bar/track, ask-AI .05).

mv.tw.fontFamily.claim: Stacks: Roobert / Reckless / Roobert Mono with system fallbacks.

mv.tw.fontSize.claim: Measured type roles (size, line-height, letter-spacing) at 1440/1280/768/390.

mv.tw.spacing.claim: Tailwind spacing aliases map to stepped CSS vars.

mv.tw.radius.claim: Radii: pill 990, full2 9990, panel 48/32/24, tab/usp 14, frame 24, hero-frame 18, transport 22, tag 28, nav-item 50, dropdown col/tile/chip 20/12/9.

mv.tw.blur.claim: Backdrop blurs nav 10, frosted 12, menu 16, timeline 24.

mv.tw.easing.claim: Easings snappy cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), plain ease, spring cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1).

mv.css.fontface.claim: Self-hosted faces: Roobert 400/500/600/700, Reckless 300/400/(500->Regular)/700, Roobert Mono 500/600/700. Commercial licensed typefaces.

citations.contains: they are NOT interpolated between 1280 and 1440

mv.css.text-wrap.claim: text-wrap: pretty set globally on html.

mv.css.buttons.claim: Button: 35.75px tall, pill radius, Mono 700 13px uppercase; filled/frosted/outlined/filled-white; hover brightness(1.1) or unfilled hover bg; transition filter/background 100ms; active brightness(.9).

mv.css.toggle-pill.claim: Workflow/Frontend toggle pill moves by clip-path inset over .28s snappy; no transition under reduced motion.

mv.css.footer-divider.claim: Footer HAS 1px dividers at 12% currentColor; accordion grid-template-rows 200ms ease below 768. (CLONE_SPEC said 'no borders' - wrong.)

mv.css.nav-accordion.claim: Mobile nav accordion grid-template-rows .25s; chevron rotate .2s. Not gated by prefers-reduced-motion in the clone.

mv.hero.frame-offset.claim: Product-visual margin-top: +45px (sp-xxl) below 640; sp-xxl - 175px = -130px at 640-1023; -(40px + max(0, min(100svh, fold-fit) - 900px)) at >=1024, i.e. -40px for viewports up to ~900px tall (-75.6px at 1440x1100). Measured identical on the live original and a fresh build of the current clone source. CLONE_SPEC's '-40px' is correct for >=1024 but incomplete.

mv.hero.frame-aspect.claim: Hero frame aspect 3:4 below 640, 4:3 from 640 until 1280, 2:1 from 1280; separate phone/tablet/desktop SVG frames.

mv.hero.copy.claim: Hero copy: NEW tag 'Introducing Tines 3B', two-line H1, byline, Book a demo (filled) + Sign up free (frosted). Centred <640, left from 640.

mv.hero.mobile-roobert.claim: <640 the hero H1 uses Roobert 500 (400 from 640) and the byline uses Roobert 500 (Reckless from 640). CLONE_SPEC listed Reckless at 390 - wrong. (Markup now lives in the shared HeroCopy component extracted from Hero.jsx.)

mv.hero.logos.claim: Marquee: 11 real third-party customer trademarks (Coinbase, Databricks, Reddit, Snowflake, Intercom, Dropbox, Pinterest, MongoDB, Sophos, Canva, McKesson), set rendered twice. (Logo list now in shared LogoSet.jsx; Hero.jsx wraps it in the marquee track.)

mv.hero.wordmark.claim: 100x wordmark stage: the static PNG is now only the accessible image + fallback until the first frame of a live canvas (HundredXField); the stage still carries data-motion hundredx-sink. (The design-repo's artwork.canvas-standin role still describes the PNG snapshot, which remains the only reference artwork.)

mv.timeline.structure.claim: Timeline bar docked on TOP of the frame (data-dock=top); caption chip above the knob with top-rounded corners; 9 segments with live-measured widths 4.09248..8.60636%; static 0:01 / 1:31.

mv.timeline.behaviour.claim: Default scene duration 91.6315s (the 1360px desktop-band value; the real duration now varies 88.0-99.5s with frame width via src/motion/timelineChapters.js), loops; 9 chapters; holds at gate t=1.8s (shows 0:01) until the visual is >=65% in view; scrub snaps to chapter within 6px.

mv.monitor.content.claim: Monitor banner: kicker, serif H2 lead + strong emphasis, ai-tangle icon, two short paragraphs; text centred at ALL widths including 390 (CLONE_SPEC said left-aligned at 390 - wrong).

mv.solution.content.claim: Solution panel: kicker, 3-line H2, 2x2 items (H3 + body), orb mascot, 'Tines 3B' footer line, Explore the product (filled-white). H3 Roobert 700 below 920, Reckless from 920.

mv.solution.bed.claim: Flower bed stand-in wrapper carries the view-timeline parallax hook.

mv.usecases.content.claim: 5 tabs (it/security/finance/people/operations) with title, short title, body; Workflow/Frontend toggle; two screenshot frames; mobile caption.

mv.usecases.grow.claim: Hover fisheye: hovered grow 1 + 24n/(w+64), neighbours gaussian exp(-d^2/5.12); flex-grow .3s snappy.

mv.usecases.wipe.claim: Tab change: wipe layer panelWipe 1s; new stage frameFloatIn .4s (+50ms inactive); instant under reduced motion.

mv.why.content.claim: Why Tines: kicker, H2, byline, radar + constellation illustration, 4 cards (bold lead + continuation, icon).

mv.cta.content.claim: Start today CTA: canvas stand-in wordmark (alt 'Start today') hosting the tri-cursor; tagline; Sign up free (filled) + Book a demo (outlined) - order reversed vs hero.

mv.footer.content.claim: Footer: 5 columns (Product, Solutions, Discover, Company, Trust and security), absolute https://www.tines.com links, multi-open accordion <768, Ask AI pill (5 assistants), (c) Tines, Cookie settings; hover colour accent #8d75e6.

mv.nav.layers.claim: Nav blur + backdrop layers are opacity 0 at top and fade in (opacity .2s ease) only when scrollY > 10 or a menu is open. (CLONE_SPEC said the header 'does not change on scroll' - wrong.)

mv.nav.links.claim: Nav items and the hero/solution/CTA buttons use ROOT-RELATIVE hrefs copied from the original (/customers/, /pricing/, /3b/, /book-a-demo/, /blog/introducing-tines-3b/) which resolve against the clone host where no such route exists; only the footer uses absolute https://www.tines.com URLs, and login/signup/docs/community are absolute subdomain URLs.

mv.nav.dropdown.claim: Desktop dropdown columns animate snappyIn .4s, staggered 50ms; mobile menu snappyDown .35s.

mv.icon.sizes.claim: Icon sizes 14 (timeline), 16 (search/hamburger), 18 (dropdown leaf, ask-AI), 24 (mobile tab icon), 48 (orb).

mv.layout.grids.claim: Solution panel grid 1fr 2fr at >=920, 2 equal columns at >=1280; USP cards 1/2/4 columns; footer 4-col grid at 768.

mv.motion.keyframes.claim: All keyframes copied from the original's compiled CSS.

mv.motion.gating.claim: Every animation lives inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) or is skipped in JS under reduce.

mv.motion.marquee.claim: Marquee period = offsetLeft of first duplicate; duration = period/40 s; drag resumes from dragged phase; not animated under reduce.

mv.motion.hundredx.claim: hundredx-sink: scroll(root) 0 -> 80vh, translateY 0 -> 45px, >=920 only, no-preference only.

mv.motion.product-visual.claim: Appear 600ms on the inner SVG only; timeline bar fade/intro 600ms delay 200ms.

mv.motion.solution.claim: Solution flower bed view-timeline parallax translateY 33% -> 12%; orb face gaze offset max r*0.14.

mv.motion.usecases-reveal.claim: Use-cases block IO reveal (threshold 0, one-shot) 500ms translateY 16 -> 0.

mv.motion.constellation.claim: USP constellation spin 60s / spinSlow 75s reverse; stars twinkle.

mv.motion.cursor.claim: CTA tri-cursor: mouse-only, spinner 6s linear (gated), fade .12s, press spring .3s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1).

mv.qa.motion.claim: Motion values re-measured on the live original (headless Playwright, this extraction session). Raw audit output was session-temporary; the values are recorded in recordedMeasurements.motion below and implemented at the cited lines.

mv.spec.no-shadows.claim: No box-shadows on static elements (spec claim confirmed by absence of shadow utilities in tailwind theme).

mv.assets.manifest.claim: ASSET_MANIFEST.json: 70 entries (10 fonts, favicon, images, canvas PNG stand-ins, inline SVGs).

mv.spec.errors.claim: CLONE_SPEC.md lines later found WRONG (see specCorrections).

recordedMeasurements.$comment: Recorded from headless Playwright audits of the live original and the clone during this extraction session. Raw JSON was session-temporary and is not shipped; these numbers are the record. Implementing code is cited via the mv.* entries named in 'implementedAt'.

pageHeights.note: original == clone. Heights depend on viewport HEIGHT (the hero fold is svh-capped): re-measured on a fresh build of the current source, 1280x800 gives 6966 and 768x1024 gives 6772, so always state the viewport height.

Hero product demo (91s scripted SVG) is a static frame; only the timeline transport plays
~300ms nav dropdown close delay not implemented (closes immediately on mouseleave)
Nav/footer accordion transitions are not gated by prefers-reduced-motion
Root-relative nav/button links are dead in the clone (only '/' exists)
